title: Training a 4B model to produce 81% faster query plans than Postgres
summary: A developer trained a 4 billion parameter model to generate SQL query execution plans that are 81% faster than PostgreSQL's native query optimizer, using reinforcement learning to learn optimal query planning strategies.
problem_solved: The query optimizer problem - finding optimal execution plans among billions of possibilities for complex SQL queries.
why_valuable: Faster query plans directly translate to reduced database latency, lower computational costs, and improved application performance at scale.
